dialogues.speaker: Hanamizaka Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Hanamizaka bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all sorts of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree operation is coming to an end, but those who conceal their Visions still remain.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Following the orders of the Tenryou Commissioner, and in compliance with the command of Madam Kujou Sara, pursuit operations will avoid using force or disrupting the public as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Please don't worry. The Tenryou Commission will not use its public duties as an excuse to intrude on your daily lives.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commissioner guarantees this in his own name, and that of the Kujou Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The First" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! I am here again! Where are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The First" Itto
dialogues.text: "I will never forget that you took my Vision away. As long as I still breathe, I will keep coming for you!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The First" Itto
dialogues.text: "Don't you ever forget that either!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Everyone, no need to worry! The Tenryou Commission will handle this vandal soon.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara promises that she has nothing to do with this person. Please do not worry.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "If any citizen discovers Ms. Yoimiya setting off restricted fireworks inside the city, please try to stop her!"

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "...Or reprimand her, at least. Do not indulge her!"

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "The Fire Brigade hereby urges everyone to pay special attention. Thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Night-time robberies, piracy, and false documentation have been rampant in Inazuma lately."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Smugglers, illegal traders, people stirring up trouble"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Imprisonment, bribery, people who travel freely"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Mandatory draft, stagnation, exploitation, and deceit"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: The above are all lies. None of this is true!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Any vandal caught will be punished severely by the Tenryou Commissioner!

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to the war, the supply of Jade Steel has stagnated temporarily."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Please wait a while longer if you have any need for Jade Steel weapon restoration or forging."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "I, Amenoma Tougo, sincerely apologize, and wish for your understanding."

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Bantan Sango: We'll investigate anything on your behalf!"

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Missing persons, missing pets, marital investigations, criminal investigations, commercial commissions, delivery services, procurement services..."

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Just make us a suitable offer, and we'll even capture the likes of bandit chiefs Zenigata or Domeki for you!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard that another shipment of goods was stranded in Ritou due to piracy."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This is ridiculous! Piracy hasn't been a problem for centuries ever since the end of Ako Domeki's reign of terror."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "As it stands, the Sakoku Decree has actually helped to revive smuggling and piracy..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If this is the will of Her Excellency the Ogosho... the will of an Archon, us mortals simply cannot fathom its meaning."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It would be advisable for you to not attempt to fathom it.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Higi Hirotaka, male, 35 years old. Retired samurai, former miner, physically fit, hard-working."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Health guaranteed, no pre-existing illnesses! In urgent need of a job to feed a family of four."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Available for interview everyday from 06:00 to 20:00!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Ritou dock job recruitment has opened. This post may be taken down.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Kiminami Restaurant will only serve the freshest and most authentic Inazuma cuisine!"

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Anyone ordering take-out will be greeted with Miss. Anna's smile!"

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "May a sweet smile bring you a beautiful day!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "She's just forcing herself to smile to bring in more business, isn't she..."

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Yoshino Koheiji, Yoshino Koheita

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, robbery, night-time assaults, conspiring against officials, distributing belongings to innocent villagers to incite rebellion.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty: Midorikawa Shirou

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, riotous assembly, piracy, robbing officials, ambushing samurai, holding family members as hostages in an attempt to rebel against the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: This person and his accomplices are wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: The fight against the rebels proceeds apace. Only one more strike, and they shall be destroyed completely.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: We hope that all young samurai will join together and fight to accomplish this great work!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Come join the army! Or you may regret not having done anything for your country when the war is over!

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Please visit the Tenryou Commission for information about joining the army.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Attention! Families that have received draft orders must send at least one adult to join the military.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This 'final strike' has been going on for three months... and yet the resistance has not been put down."

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: What right do those who haven't joined the army have to criticize the samurai fighting on the front line? It's because of their protection that you are able to complain!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I am too old to take to the battlefield, and I thank all the young people for their contributions... it's just that my three sons have yet to come home."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Could the Tenryou Commissioner please grant my son a few days' leave to come home so that I shall not have any lingering regrets on account of this war?"

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: We hope for this father's kind understanding on the matter. We know that everyone has family members at the frontline and everyone is restless, but please bear with us a bit more. Victory will be ours soon.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Let's hope so. Let's hope so..."

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Defacing of military draft notices is prohibited! Anyone caught again will face a heavy penalty!

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We ask that those in need of help visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's all a lie! When it was my turn yesterday, I was told that there was nothing left!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "There must be more food in the Yashiro Commission granaries, right? Lady Yae Miko, please do not let those so-called officials fool you!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We are truly sorry. Let us pray together for the war to end. Things will get better soon.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...Can't even say anything useful, can you?"

dialogues.speaker: Agent Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Thanks to the careful consideration of Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki, the Vision Hunt Decree was implemented swiftly, preventing those who opposed it from fleeing."

dialogues.speaker: Agent Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The real estate assets of the fugitives will be rented out or sold today. The Tenryou Commission guarantees the legitimacy of these transactions!"
